highlights: Major AI labs like Google DeepMind and NVIDIA are releasing highly specialized and open-weight models, advancing capabilities in cyber defense, coding, and multilingual transcription, while also fostering broader community access.

The AI agent ecosystem is rapidly maturing with new open-source frameworks enabling flexible skill integration and recursive self-improvement, alongside critical infrastructure tools like a vector index that dramatically shrinks RAG memory footprint.

Strategic partnerships between OpenAI and enterprise giants like ServiceNow and Oracle are expanding AI agent integration across core business workflows, signaling significant industry adoption and the evolving role of AI in enterprise.

agents.title: Infini-AI-Lab Releases Hermit: Open-Source Harness Adapter for AI Agents
agents.summary: Infini-AI-Lab has open-sourced Hermit, an Apache-2.0 harness adapter framework that allows AI agents to learn new instructions, skills, memory, and tools from task feedback without altering the agent’s core model or harness, enabling flexible and efficient agent development.

agents.title: The Trinity: Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
agents.summary: This research introduces 'The Trinity,' a framework for multimodal agents to achieve recursive self-improvement by coupling world generation with harness evolution, enabling agents to learn and evolve reusable capability modules autonomously and generalize across diverse tasks.

agents.title: MiniMax Open-Sources MCode Stack: 15 Agent Skills for Coding
agents.summary: MiniMax has open-sourced MCode Stack, an MIT-licensed repository featuring 15 practical agent skills and checklists that its MiniMax Code team uses daily for tasks like code review, subagent splits, and managing long-running commands, offering valuable resources for developer agents.

models.title: Google DeepMind Introduces Gemini 4 Carbon: Top Model for Cyber Defense and Coding
models.summary: Google DeepMind unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model scoring high on AI benchmarks (59 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro) and optimized for cyber defense and coding, with initial access for vetted cyber defenders at tiered token pricing.

models.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: Open 30B MoE for 40-Language Transcription
models.summary: NVIDIA has released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weights 30B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) speech LLM with ~4.3B active parameters that transcribes 40 languages, adds speaker labels and word timestamps, and achieves a 4.71% mean WER on English Open ASR Leaderboard.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM3: 6 Open-Weight 2B-Class Multimodal Models
models.summary: Liquid AI has launched LFM3, a collection of six open-weight, 2B-class multimodal models for text, vision, audio, omni-modal, and decision tasks. LFM3-1.7B, featuring a tri-hybrid backbone and 256K context window, fits in approximately 1 GB at 4-bit, making advanced multimodal AI more accessible.

tools.title: LEANN: Open-Source Vector Index Shrinks RAG Index from 201 GB to 6 GB
tools.summary: UC Berkeley's LEANN is an open-source vector index that drastically reduces the memory footprint for RAG indices, shrinking a 60M-chunk index from 201 GB to just 6 GB while maintaining HNSW accuracy at 90% recall, significantly improving cost-efficiency for large-scale RAG deployments.

tools.title: AssemblyAI Ships AssemblyAI-TTS-1: $15 per 1M Character Text-to-Speech API for Voice Agents
tools.summary: AssemblyAI has released AssemblyAI-TTS-1, a new Text-to-Speech API designed for voice agents, priced at $15 per 1 million characters. It offers unlimited concurrency without a contract and supports six languages at launch, providing a scalable and affordable solution for voice AI development.

tools.title: Introducing AnySpeechRecognizer and AnyDecisionModel: Open Models for Apple Platforms
tools.summary: Hugging Face announced AnySpeechRecognizer and AnyDecisionModel, new open models optimized for Apple platforms, providing developers with readily available, open-source solutions for integrating speech recognition and decision-making capabilities into local and mobile AI applications.

companies.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow Expand Partnership Across Enterprise Workflows
companies.summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow are expanding their partnership to integrate OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow platforms, and ServiceNow workflows into ChatGPT and Codex, significantly broadening AI capabilities and adoption within enterprise environments.

companies.title: OpenAI Expands Partnership with Oracle to Bring Its Apps to ChatGPT
companies.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their collaboration to integrate Oracle's business applications and AI agents directly into ChatGPT, and to power new Oracle AI offerings, reinforcing the trend of AI embedding deeper into critical enterprise software stacks.

companies.title: OpenAI Publishes Updated Model Spec for Capable and Beneficial AI
companies.summary: OpenAI has published an updated Model Spec outlining five core values that will guide the development of more capable AI systems towards sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent, setting a new standard for responsible AI deployment.

learning.title: Google’s Newest AI Quest: Mapping the Human Brain for AI Literacy
learning.summary: Google has launched 'Polar Peaks,' its latest AI Quest lesson focused on neuroscience and mapping the human brain, offering an educational opportunity for individuals to learn AI literacy through engaging, scientific exploration.

learning.title: Counting the Bandages: On Measuring the Time That AI Saves
learning.summary: This paper presents a framework for rigorously measuring the actual time saved by AI assistance, contrasting stopwatch metrics with a 'ledger view' that accounts for defects, and provides empirical findings on AI's impact on developer productivity, offering critical insights for AI deployment analysis.

learning.title: Why and How to Do Science When AI Is Better at It: A Framework for Human Understanding
learning.summary: This paper proposes a framework for human scientists to navigate research in an era where AI can outperform them, focusing on the indispensable aims of durable human understanding and direction, providing guidance for preserving human agency and explainability in AI-augmented scientific endeavors.
